$rule: Every entry below is a hand-curated performance-budget ledger, NOT a script-regenerated file (contrast perf/t0-baseline.json and perf/web-budget-result.json, which ARE overwritten wholesale by every `pnpm perf:t0` / `pnpm perf:web-budget` run). If a PR changes ANY field of an entry in this file (budget value, lastMeasured*, status, enforced) vs the version on `main`, that entry's `reason` string MUST also change in the same diff — scripts/perf-baseline-check.mjs enforces this in CI's perf-t0 job and fails the build otherwise. This exists so a budget can never be quietly loosened (or a regression quietly baselined-away) without a human explaining why in the commit itself. See docs/developer-guide/architecture/performance-budgets.md for the full policy.

budgets.description: Idle RSS of the server process alone, docs/PLAN.md §9.2 ('server process alone <= 220 MB'). Hard-enforced by scripts/perf-t0.mjs.
budgets.reason: Phase 2/P2.6 initial enforcement baseline. Measured locally (macOS, dev hardware) via `pnpm perf:t0` against the 50k-item `pnpm db:seed-large` library, immediately after server boot + 500ms settle, before any HTTP traffic. Observed range across 4 local reruns: 144.4-154.4 MiB, vs 220 MiB budget — comfortable headroom.

budgets.description: docs/PLAN.md §9.2 'Idle RSS (server + worker + embedded PG) <= 500 MB' stack figure. Reported by scripts/perf-t0.mjs as server+worker RSS ONLY (embedded PG doesn't exist yet — D1: it's a Phase-4 packaging concern; today's PG is the external dev-compose container, not part of this Node stack) — informational, NOT hard-enforced, since it structurally can't represent the full number it's named after.
budgets.reason: Phase 2/P2.6 initial baseline. server(144-154 MiB) + worker(242-261 MiB, best-effort tsx-run measurement) ~= 386-410 MiB vs the documented 500 MiB stack figure. Not hard-enforced pending embedded-PG packaging (Phase 4).

budgets.description: GET /movies?libraryId=...&limit=200 (the /browse route's data endpoint) p95 over HTTP, docs/PLAN.md §9.2 hot path 'browse page'. 200 samples cycling through 41 real keyset-paginated pages walked across the 50k-item Large Library. Hard-enforced.
budgets.reason: First ENFORCING CI run breached (209.8ms on ubuntu @50k): listCatalogItems used the (library_id,item_type) index then filtered+sorted the whole 50k-row library per page, and the OR-form keyset was a per-row Filter so deep pages re-walked their whole prefix. Fixed: migration 0009 composite keyset indexes + ROW-comparison cursor (Index Cond seek, EXPLAIN-verified 0.06ms). Re-measured 10.49ms locally 2026-07-24.

budgets.description: GET /movies/{id} p95 over HTTP, docs/PLAN.md §9.2 hot path 'item detail'. 200 samples, each a distinct item id drawn from across the 50k-item library. Hard-enforced.
budgets.reason: Phase 2/P2.6 initial enforcement baseline, measured via `pnpm perf:t0` against db:seed-large (50k movies). Observed range across 4 local reruns: 1.6-2.3ms vs 100ms budget. Updated 2026-07-23: 2.32ms -> 6.83ms after detail people[]/mediaFiles[] joins landed (includeDetail opt-in, gap-closure ede9d33) — still 14x under budget.

budgets.reason: Phase 2/P2.6 initial enforcement baseline, measured via `pnpm perf:t0`. Observed range across 4 local reruns: 1.9-2.5ms vs 100ms budget.

budgets.description: GET /search?q=... p95 over HTTP, docs/PLAN.md §9.2 hot path 'search-as-you-type'. 200 samples cycling through 20 real title-adjective query terms against the 50k-item library. Hard-enforced.
budgets.reason: Phase 2 gap-closure fix (commit ede9d33): migration 0008 pg_trgm GIN expression indexes on people.name::text/tags.name::text + searchCatalog restructured from OR/correlated-EXISTS into a UNION of three independently-planned branches. p95 159.1ms -> 22.59ms; re-measured 21.77ms post-0009 @50k seed (leak suite unchanged, 25th dedup test added). Re-measured 2026-07-23 via pnpm perf:t0.

budgets.description: Scanner throughput (walk+hash+parse+db-write) over 500 deterministic fake movie files, docs/PLAN.md §9.2 'scan throughput >= 200 files/min on HDD'. Hard-enforced (was warn-only through Phase 1, D15 flips this in Phase 2).

budgets.reason: DFX-2026-08-31 re-stamp (doc-audit finding V03-V1): 169,493 -> 180,172 B, the figure perf/web-budget-result.json recorded at the RZI-2026-08-30 close. The +10,679 B accrued unstamped across the runs after the 2026-07-25 Blaze W2 stamp: +9,563 B by the rc.6 QA remediation (D-3 flagged the gap at its Phase 0 and parked it), +767 B at the UIFIX-2026-08-29 close (commit 6848e90 recorded 179,823 B without re-stamping this entry), +349 B at the RZI-2026-08-30 close. Now 12.0% under the 200 KB budget.
